parameters.query:
SELECT r.client, r.email, r.name, s.week, s.r2_key, l.id AS share
FROM reportes.recipients r
JOIN reportes.client_tokens t ON t.client = r.client AND t.active
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT week, r2_key FROM reportes.snapshots WHERE client = r.client ORDER BY week DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true
LEFT JOIN reportes.share_links l ON l.client = r.client AND l.revoked_at IS NULL
LEFT JOIN reportes.sends d ON d.client = r.client AND d.week = s.week
WHERE r.active = true AND d.id IS NULL
ORDER BY r.client

INSERT INTO reportes.sends (client, week, to_email, r2_key)
SELECT j->>'client', j->>'week', j->>'to', j->>'r2key'
FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j) p
ON CONFLICT (client, week) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, client, week, to_email
